title: PM-MCP corpus source manifest
description: sources/<name>/manifest.json of the model verification corpus: the public repository a dataset is fetched from, the commit it is pinned to, its licence and the files read from it with their SHA-256. The schema uses only the keyword subset the corpus validator evaluates.

name.description: the source name, the directory below sources/

repository.description: the repository the files are fetched from, an absolute https URI without user, query or fragment

licence.description: the SPDX licence identifier of the dataset

path.description: the repository-relative path of the file

sha256.description: the SHA-256 of the file, or of the LFS object if the file is an LFS pointer

lfs.description: true if the file is stored as a Git LFS pointer
